skill_interface: structured JSON in; KAC objects out
source_policy: Only manifest Knowledge source_refs may ground claims.
tool_policy: No network or external action during verdict execution.
guardrail: Never skip required measurement boundaries, assert SDG impact without evidence, or execute a transaction.
validation_rule: Verdict is PROCEED, REVIEW, or STOP; path is contiguous and evidence uses admitted sources.
trace_policy: Record context, chain and runtime versions plus input and decision hashes.
approval_policy: Human approval is required for external ESG or SDG claims.
invocation_contract: One input creates one immutable run directory and DB event set.
release_policy: Only compiled fingerprints passing regression tests may run.
